stories.title: Family pay tribute to 'loving and caring' man
stories.summary: The collision took place on the A1067 at Kettlestone on 4 November, Norfolk Police said.

stories.title: Motorcyclist airlifted to hospital after crash
stories.summary: Norfolk Police says the motorcyclist, a man in his 40s, is in a critical condition.

stories.title: Bird flu confirmed at commercial poultry site

stories.title: Police probe car park damage after football match

stories.title: Care home resident 'covered in blood' at breakfast
stories.summary: CQC inspectors find member of staff at the Wymondham home working 60 hours without a break.

stories.title: F1 driver George Russell opens youth karting academy
stories.summary: The GR63 Karting Academy, for eight and nine-year-olds, is based at Kart Silverstone.

stories.title: City Hall clock tower could be opened to the public
stories.summary: Norwich City Council has submitted plans for a refurbishment of its listed headquarters.

stories.title: Bus operator says 69 stops affected by roadworks
stories.summary: Norfolk County Council says it tries to minimise disruption during busier times of the year.

stories.title: Driver danced and drank in pub before killing cyclist
stories.summary: He drank up to six pints before murdering a father-of-three by knocking him off his bicycle in rage.

stories.title: New £10m hotel approved at former factory site
stories.summary: A councillor says the hotel is a "vote of confidence" in the town.

stories.title: Campaigners want more land protected from housing

stories.title: Drink-driver guilty of road rage cyclist murder
stories.summary: The Mercedes driver swerved into the cyclist after they got into an argument, a court hears.
